title: 第7章
content_zh:
展颜被人搡到棺材前，按着跪下，一双双眼都盯在她身上，有说这么小就没了娘可怜的，有说这闺女真是俊跟娘一样的，主事的老汉，交代了她几句话。
展颜说不出话，主事的老汉急了，说：“好孩子，你倒是让你妈躲钉啊！你不喊，你妈咋能知道呢？”
四面八方全是声音，展颜手心一阵麻，脑袋空空，嘴巴却怎么也张不开，奶奶挤过来卷起袖子就想扇她，被人拦下。
舅舅拿起斧头，包着红布，一钉子砸进去，扬声喊道：“一钉添丁又进财！”
有什么呢？展颜手里拿着一朵纸折的白莲花，妈进了棺材，而她实实在在的只拥有这一朵纸莲花。
她跟着队伍上山，杏花开得跟雪堆似的，风野，草也冒了头，田里的庄稼，经了场雨，长得更快了。
奶奶在训她：“呆会下地时，你要是再不听话回家就让你爸揍你，让你哭你就得哭！”
“她的眼泪流干了，哭不出就不哭，别逼她，”贺以诚开口了，他声音不高，“眼泪不是流给别人看的，况且，以后她哭的时候你们也未必看得到。”
奶奶本来想发火，可一见这人模样，发作不起来，闷声骂了句什么，谁也没听懂。
至于贺以诚是什么时候离开的，展颜并不知道，她很疲惫，像是身体成了魂魄的累赘，下了山就睡觉，醒了哭一会儿，又睡着了。
她请了几天假，在家里也不怎么吃东西，坐着发呆，看日头一点点往西挪，从院墙过去，奶奶则吃了晚饭后在油黑的灯泡下翻礼薄，嘴里念念有词。
展有庆还得下井，换上工作服，脑袋上戴着照明灯，见展颜坐那儿，他站了会儿，才把一个小木箱子给她。
content_en:
Zhan Yan was pushed to the coffin and pushed to his knees. All eyes were fixed on her. Some said it was pitiful to lose her mother at such a young age, while others said that this girl was as handsome as her mother. The old man in charge told her a few words.
Zhan Yan was speechless, and the old man in charge became anxious and said, "Good boy, you let your mother hide from you! How could your mother know if you didn't shout?"
There were sounds from all directions. Zhanyan's palms were numb, her head was empty, but her mouth couldn't be opened. Grandma squeezed over and rolled up her sleeves to slap her, but someone stopped her.
The uncle picked up the axe, wrapped it in red cloth, smashed a nail in, and shouted: "One nail will make a child and make a fortune!"
What's there? Zhanyan held a paper-folded white lotus in her hand. Mom entered the coffin, but she really only owned this paper lotus.
She followed the team up the mountain. The apricot blossoms were blooming like snowdrifts, the wind was wild, and the grass was sprouting. The crops in the fields grew faster after the rain.
Grandma was training her: "When you go to the ground for a while, if you don't obey me again and come home, your dad will beat you. If he makes you cry, you have to cry!"
"Her tears have dried up. If she can't cry, don't cry. Don't force her," He Yicheng said, his voice low. "The tears are not for others to see. Besides, you may not be able to see her when she cries in the future."
Grandma originally wanted to get angry, but when she saw this man's appearance, she couldn't get angry and cursed something in a low voice, but no one understood.
As for when He Yicheng left, Zhanyan didn't know. She was very tired, as if her body had become a burden on her soul. She went to sleep when she got down the mountain, woke up and cried for a while, then fell asleep again.
She took a few days off and didn't eat much at home. She sat in a daze, watching the sun move westward little by little and past the courtyard wall. After dinner, grandma was flipping through the gift book under the dark light bulb and mumbling something.
Zhan Youqing had to go down the well, put on work clothes, and put on a light on his head. Seeing Zhan Yan sitting there, he stood for a while before giving her a small wooden box.
